comment: Junctions that must be looked at by a person, and must NOT be sent to a model again.
A junction lands here when repeated runs fail on it for DIFFERENT reasons. That pattern says
the junction itself is the problem, not the weather: retrying it burns the full provider
ceiling and returns nothing, every time. Keyed by junction key, which is built from OSM node
ids and so survives re-enumeration; the name is for humans and is not matched on.
Remove an entry once the junction has been adjudicated, or once the cause is understood and
fixed. This list should only ever shrink.

junctions.name: Ulica 153. brigade Hrvatske vojske × Ulica Slavka Kolara
junctions.why: Five failures across two providers on three unrelated causes: ECONNRESET, the 15-minute ceiling, then the 25-minute ceiling at 1507 s, twice. Raising the limit did not rescue it, so it is not a timeout problem. Eleven fused nodes, 8 arms and 56 lanes: the movement space is far larger than anything else being solved, and it is plausibly too big to answer in one pass rather than broken in any way. Needs splitting or adjudicating by hand, not another run.
